name: premier-fantasy
description: Fantasy Football Manager basado en la Premier League

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build:render: npm run build:render -w server && npm run build -w client
